capabilities: Transcribe live or after the recording
Generate templated notes and a mind-map overview
Import audio, MP4 and text transcripts
Extract people, todos, learning cards and hotwords
extras: Ships no API keys and has no account or server; cloud services receive audio, transcript text and prompt context. Proprietary license since 2.2.0 with source no longer released, and detailed usage instructions live in an external user manual.
problem: Recording a meeting and writing it up in Obsidian means juggling a separate recorder, a transcription service and manual note formatting.

relations.evidence: The HTML slide-deck feature in earlier versions was inspired by alchaincyf/huashu-design

requires.name: Virtual audio device (BlackHole, PulseAudio/PipeWire monitor) for system audio on macOS or Linux

summary: Meeting recorder that captures audio in Obsidian, transcribes it live or afterwards, and turns it into AI-organized Markdown notes with a mind-map overview.
